description: This file implements a Netlink utility class that handles creating netlink sockets, sending route requests, reading messages, and parsing route information (including default route detection) on Linux systems. It is part of the 'WPEFramework::Plugin' namespace.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: A utility class for managing Linux netlink sockets, sending route requests, and parsing network route information.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Creates and binds a netlink socket configured for a specific group, setting it to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the netlink socket with optional timeout.

methods.name: getDefaultInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves default network interface indices and gateway addresses by sending route requests.

methods.name: displayMessages
methods.description: Logs contents of netlink messages for debugging.
